t: Make your way to the Crystal Mountain and find a rift in reality. Summon Charles de Doucer from the rift and report to him.

While you and some members of the Resistance were looking for ways to fight Lictors, others have combed through most of Irdrich. We found plenty of interesting information, but nothing monumental. Tep keeps a tight grip on his victims, and so far his world is not even wobbling.
The only place we haven't explored is that mountain in the north. The aviaks are too scared to go there, and you can't get there by ground: a deep chasm lies between the mountain and the Windy Hills. I suspect that Tep doesn't want us to go there. And so we must go there!
Your objective is to get to the other side and find a rift in reality. It's enough for someone to open the way from the other side - that will expedite the whole process.
There are more rifts in the illusion with each passing day... But it doesn't seem to weaken the enemy whatsoever.
Have you found the key to the last puzzle? That's great! I will signal the Resistance to start searching the Crystal Mountain.
Question Alk Two-Arrows, Phell Sharp-Sighted and Koati Close-Lipped about the mountain in the north. Report to the Pudgy family at the League Settlement.

There you are. We were afraid that we won't see you again. The Resistance has cut off Tep's supplies. You could say we've stirred up the hornets' nest, he he!
We've combed through all the local swamps and islands and even the sea. The center of the illusion is not here, that's for certain. This leaves only one possible location. Do you see that mountain in the north? That's where we must look for it.
The problem is that a huge gorge separates that mountain from us. There are no bridges, no squawker will go there, and despite all our efforts to talk to the locals, they just cluck their beaks in response. Could be fear, could be that this place is taboo... The point is, we don't know anything about it. Maybe you could try talking to them? They respect you, perhaps they'll tell you something.
Whenever we ask about it, their eyes pop out and they lose the ability to speak. What's up with that mountain?
So they haven't told you anything either? Who is this Ulumi Half-Wing? Perhaps he'll cough up some information?
Find Ulumi Half-Wing in the Muggy Jungle and ask him about the Crystal Mountain.

It seems that Uli-Muli Half-Whatshisname is our only clue. We saw him while looking for the rift, but didn't pay him any mind. He's an old cripple with crazy eyes and feathers so dirty we can't even tell if he's red-winged or white! He roams the Muggy Jungle in solitude, chewing something foul and muttering under his beak. It seems unlikely that he'll give us any useful information... But it's worth a shot.
Who are you? You've come to laugh at an old cripple? Cough, cough... Ha! Look at yourself: you don't have any wings! Ha ha ha... Kha-khrr...
Who attacked? Ulumi attacked? Who's crazy here, Ulumi or you wingless? Kharr... There was no fight!
Make your way to the Crystal Mountain and find a rift in reality. Summon Charles de Doucer from the rift and report to him.

While you were crawling around the swamp, killing Imperial scums, the Resistance warriors have searched the entire Irdrich. And you know what? Nothing! No Lictors, no center of illusion, no new rifts! Evidently, a couple of holes in the fabric of the illusory world won't make it collapse. What a pity!
The only place we haven't looked at is that mountain in the north. Aviaks are terrified of it, and you can't get there on foot - there is a massive gorge between the Windy Hills and the southern island. This is hardly accidental. Tep doesn't want to let us go there, which means we have to find a way at any cost!
Find a way to get across the abyss. If you find any rifts in the illusion on the other side, use it to summon Charles de Doucer. He'll get the rest of there in a jiffy - don't you worry about that!
There are more rifts in the illusion with each passing day... But it doesn't seem to weaken the enemy whatsoever.
Have you found the key to the last puzzle? That's great! I will signal the Resistance to start searching the Crystal Mountain.
Sneak into the Historians' camp, steal the Containers of Dark Artifacts, and bring them to Anatoly Aldanov, Imperial diplomat.

So, the Historians bought some dark artifacts from the goblins. That is a bit unexpected. Well we need to do something! And now!
Go to the Historians' Camp near Tensess Temple and confiscate the Dark Artifacts immediately! I'm sure that League agents are on their way already. We need to get them first!
What's happening with the artifacts? Don't tell me that the League got there first!
Oh! Praise Yasker! Here they are! The dark artifacts are finally ours!
Kill Krut the Tormentor, take his Mysterious Key, and relay the information to Anatoly Aldanov.

Praise Tensess! Finally someone to share this load with! The unimaginable has happened! Recently Chairman Vissarion Arhivin arrived at the camp, and vanished just as quickly. Apparently he went into the heart of the Temple, meaning he must know how to get through the magical barrier!
But that's not all. He left a goblin in charge of the camp, without so much as talking to me first! Now Krut the Tormentor is running things. This camp has become our prison and he our jailer! He has forbid the Historians from leaving the camp! Oh, the injustice!
I fear that there is only one explanation for this - Chairman Arhivin has been bought by the demon worshippers! The Historians have been lied to! Our good name is soiled!
But the most recent crisis is that Krut is planning to deliver a batch of the Dark Artifacts into the Temple! That means he must also know how to get through the barrier. Perhaps he even has something like a key...
You must search him and then inform someone of this crisis. The Empire or the League - it doesn't matter who! Just put an end to Arhivin's schemes and clear the Historians' good name!

Vissarion Arhivin is a traitor?! Hmm... I never did trust those Historians...
Say, that's a strange key. I've never seen anything like it. I'm not a Historian, but I would venture a guess that it's of Zem origin...

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Use the Mysterious Key near the main entrance to Tensess Temple.

Oh great Nezeb! Please make it so this mysterious key gets us through the main gate of Tensess Temple! We desperately need to get in there and search for Nefer Ur. It would be even nicer if we could find Arhivin as well!
Well, we know for sure that it doesn't open the side doors, since those have been accessible for a while. I have a good feeling about this! Go up to the main gate and try to activate the key. May the Light be with you!
Hmm, a key with an intricate Zem design. It has to open the main entrance to the Temple, it has to!
It worked! The key worked! You were able to get inside! This is fantastic! Now turn back around and find Nefer Ur!
Find Nefer Ur in the Heart of Tensess Temple.

Once you get inside Tensess Temple, the first thing you should do is find Nefer Ur! We haven't had contact with him since he went inside, so I hope that everything's all right...
Find him and then do everything he says. I'm sure he knows what's going on and you can undoubtedly help. If Nefer Ur doesn't know how to put everything in order, then nobody does! He will deal both with the Historians and the cultists! And with the great Tensess, if need be.

Hmm, help has arrived sooner than I had anticipated. Yes, I suppose I did underestimate the Empire. I was sure you'd waste another two to three months dallying around the Temple before thinking to shake the answers out of those treacherous Historians.
It's probably a good thing that I was mistaken... Anyhow, tell me what's been happening on the outside. They we can proceed to fix things in here.

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Search for Vissarion Arhivin in the Corridors of Tensess Temple.

I guess you better do as the Historian suggested and try to find Vissarion Arhivin inside Tensess Temple. The League knows that we possess proof of their guilt. Sure as I'm standing here, they're hard at work at devising new lies. Which means the sooner you find Arhivin, the better.
The main Temple entrance is the one heavily guarded by mercenaries. The Historians are intent on letting no one in through that door.
But there are two others as well. They, too, used to be guarded by fighters on the Historians' payroll. But after the chaos that occurred, many of their forces ran into the temple along with Arhivin. The rest were concentrated at the main entrance to prevent another security breach.
Find Arhivin and relay everything we know of the League's insidious ways! And hurry, don't let anything stand in your way!

This area is relatively safe, so feel free to relax and get some rest. But your meeting with Arhivin will have to wait, I'm afraid.
I was accompanying him and this is where he met with Nefer Ur. Don't you worry, they negotiated a truce. The League's guilt has been proven beyond a reasonable doubt.
Nefer Ur and Arhivin then decided to go on and investigate what the cultists have been up to in the Temple. As I'm sure you noticed, they somehow managed to flood the place. We started our ascent, I was bringing up the rear.
But then a magical barrier appeared out of nowhere, cutting me off from my party. I wasn't able to break through, and so I was forced to stay behind. I can teleport back to camp, but I cannot go any further. Sigh...

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Kill Rama the Cruel and inform Pavel Osechkin.

Friggin' finally! I was beginning to think we were abandoned altogether! I entered the Temple together with Nefer Ur, with the Historians' mercenary squads right behind us.
The Great Mage proceeded further inside, while my comrades and I remained here to cover his rear. No more League soldiers followed us, just the Historians and their mercenaries. We're under strict orders not to engage them, so we thought we were in the clear.
But then word spread that there were some cultists up ahead or something, and the mercenaries went crazy! They said things had gotten too out of control and all invaders needed to be purged. What's worse is that Rama is among their ranks. He's their leader and he's a real badass, scarier than anything you've ever seen.
If you take him out, the mercenaries might become disorganized enough for us to mop up the rest of 'em. If you happen to run into him, take him down, but you best be ready for a tough fight.
Don't take another step, beast! Oh, I'm sorry. I thought you were Rama!

You're telling me you actually managed to slay that beast?! May the Astral devour his filthy remains! I still can't understand why the Historians kept that thing around. He was totally cracked I tell you. Good thing he's gone or he'd be the end of us soon enough!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Search for Nefer Ur in the Corridors of Tensess Temple.

I was traveling with Nefer Ur when we stumbled upon a group of cultists. I can only guess as to how those scumbags got in here, and it's not like they're aching to spill their secrets!
The Great Mage ordered me to go back and sound the alarm. So I set out and ran back, only to run into a Historians' mercenary squad that had run after Arhivin. As soon as I mentioned the cult, they became convinced that everyone was their enemies, even us! They went berserk and I've been hiding here ever since.
I really need to get out and report this matter to my superiors. It looks like you've cleared the way, so maybe I can finally make a dash for it. Cultists in Tensess Temple are no laughing matter! But you should go up ahead and find Nefer Ur, he might need help.

Nefer Ur isn't here. He and Arhivin headed deep into the Temple!
The Great Mage of the Arisen realized how serious this cultist invasion is. As of this moment we have no information as to their numbers, plans, or even how they got in! And that's why he went up ahead with the rest of his team and the Historians to figure things out.
Unfortunately, this magical barrier is blocking our way. Until we figure out a way to get past it, you're going to have to wait to speak with Nefer Ur.

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Relay Sarang Nubkhaes' message to Anatoly Aldanov at the Imperial camp outside Tensess Temple.

I'll stay here to study the barrier. Perhaps I'll find a way to break through or even disable it.
Head back outside and tell the Imperial diplomat that the conflict between the Historians and the Empire has been settled.
Secondly, tell him about the cultists. Their sudden appearance in the Temple is a truly troubling sign. I'm not sure how we will proceed next.

Nefer Ur and Arhivin have reached an armistice! What splendid news!
Still, I'd really prefer to see them both right here, where it's safe. Who knows what dangers may await them beyond that bizarre magical barrier? I'm especially concerned about the cult... What could they possibly want with the Temple?

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Meet with Kirill Sechin at the Imperial Camp in the Holy Land.

I believe it is time for you to leave the Empire. Not forever, of course. In fact, I would strongly recommend that you return periodically and report on your achievements. It's just that I believe your talents would be better utilized elsewhere.
I'm talking about the Holy Land. It's a large allod, discovered in the year 911 and located between the Empire and Kania. It is an ancient land that still remembers the dawn of the June civilization and the demise of the Zem.
The Holy Land is also where you'll find a large temple built by Tep. Nowadays the pyramid is referred to as Tensess Temple. And for good reason, for it is in this very pyramid where the soul of the Great Mage resides.
Whoever takes possession of it shall gain control of the world's holy magic. If we are successful, the League's priests and paladins will be stripped of their abilities, and none of their soldiers will ever be able to use Tensess' Gift to be reborn after death. It is of the utmost importance that we seize it. Am I making myself clear?
The Holy Land is where the future of Sarnaut will be decided. For years war has raged across the Holy Land, and still no victor has emerged. Perhaps it is you who will finally tip the scales and determine the outcome of this struggle.
Make for the Nezebgrad Port and speak with the port commandant. There are regular passages headed to the Holy Land and he will guide you to the correct dock.
More tourists? Oh, please, you can't be serious...
Obtain permission to visit Tensess Temple from Historian Nomarkh Taltal and report back to Kirill Sechin.

It's good that you're here. I've got a very important job for you.

Nefer Ur, the Great Mage of the Arisen and the leader of the ZIT, wishes to visit Tensess Temple. Now, according to our current agreement with the Historians, access to Tensess Temple is strictly controlled by them. That means we'll need to obtain a proper permission from their leaders. That's where you come in!

One of the Historians, an archeologist named Nomarkh Taltal, is currently conducting research at the Miktlan Ruins in the northeast part of Asee-Teph. I'm sure the archeologist would appreciate a helping hand. Your mission is to gain his favor and obtain the permission.

And don't delay! It has come to our attention that the League has also submitted a request to access the Temple on behalf of one of their paladin's, Voisvet Belov. I'm certain that Nefer Ur would very much prefer to be the first one in, so get going!
You got permission from the Historian? Great job!

I remember speaking with Vissarion Arhivin, the Historians' representative. As soon as he started outlining the peculiarities of June architecture, I went and dozed right off! It's real torture socializing with those researchers, but somehow you managed to cozy up to them!
I only hope they didn't torment you too much with their stupid lectures! Hoho! Aye, Nefer Ur will be pleased.

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Bury 6 Fake Artifacts near the Historians' excavation site. Report back to Vlada Merinova in the Central Imperial Camp.

It's good that those League seers have been taken care of. Now we can proceed to plant our own propaganda.
The Historians are excavating various June settlements throughout the Holy Land. They would do well to discover ancient Xadaganian tools, household items, and other such trinkets. Then we can stake a claim that the allod previously belonged to the Empire, and that our ancestors came to these lands after the demise of the June and Zem people.
One of the Historians' biggest excavations is over at the Miktlan Ruins, far to the northeast of here. I was sent several ancient artifacts from the national museum in Nezebgrad. All you need to do is bury them at the excavation site so they can find them later. Now head over there and make this happen.
I personally planned this operation, and the last thing I want is to look foolish in the eyes of the City Council. Did you manage to hide the artifacts at the excavation site?

The museum curator didn't want to let these artifacts go, but it's a necessary sacrifice. They Historians may be smart, but there's no way they'll figure this trick out. Then the Holy Land will be recognized as the legal property of the Empire!
Seize the June Stronghold, activate the June artifact, and report back to Kirill Sechin.

It looks like it's your turn to pass through the "June Meat Grinder." Don't look at me like that! Who else but you can survive this mission?

No one, that's who!

The "June Meat Grinder" is our pet name for the ancient June Stronghold that's on the eastern edge of the jungle.

The name is well earned, for the region is as dangerous as they come. There's an ancient June artifact hidden within the ruins, and it's highly coveted by pretty much everyone - our scientists, the Historians, as well as the League's mages. And for good reason! The artifact, which remains functional to this day, submits the June golems to the will of the artifact's owners. Are you following my drift? The golems will fight for whoever controls the artifact! That's why both the League and the Empire want the place so badly. The Historians want it too, but they're scared straight and prefer to steer clear altogether, haha!

I reckon it's high time to put an end to this shindig. Meaning we should seize control of the artifact once and for all. And that's where you come in! Get to it!
We must not allow any more golems to fight on the side of the League!
The June artifact is now under our control, and the golems are mowing down the League's troops like grass! Excellent work, you've served the Empire well! Now I wonder how long this will last...
Disrupt the cultists' ritual near the June Stronghold by killing 4 Darksoul Mentalists and report back to Colonel Braid.

I will admit that some strange cultists have started showing up. But that doesn't mean they're summoning real demons or anything. But... Well, let's just say this isn't the first tip we've gotten about them.
I've received a report recently that a group of odd and unsavory characters have been hanging around a Site of Power, the one to the east by the June Stronghold.
This information needs to be investigated. We can't have those vermin conducting their rituals and desecrating yet another Site of Power...
Head on over there. If you see cultists - kill them. By now I'm sure you know what they look like. And if they start some filthy ritual of theirs, make sure it doesn't go through. You got me?
Well, what have you got for me? All quiet at the June Stronghold?

What?! They really were there? Well, I'll be damned! It's good that you stopped them - we can't have them disrupting another Site of Power. Now we need to figure out what those crazy cult bastards were doing.
Bring the Demon Heart to Colonel Braid at the Central Imperial Camp.

Good news, it looks like the Black Ritual was disrupted in time. The demon ended up being weaker than the Predator! I bet it's because it wasn't in the jungle for very long didn't have enough time to absorb all the magic of this place. Its heart must be brought to Colonel Braid at once. Measures must be taken!
Quit sticking that crud in my face! I told you I don't want to have anything to do with those demons. And that thing reeks really badly.
Use the repellent on 6 dead Imperial Soldiers. Report back to Swamper the Merciless in the June Stronghold.

We're taking heavy losses out here. And it's not even those damned League militants that are the worst. It's the damn hyenas!
The bodies of our fallen warriors attract these predators. They feast upon their flesh so that our soldiers often rise with no arms or legs. Sometimes they don't rise at all. And they are useless in battle and traumatized for life.
I requested help from headquarters, and the Arisen scientists sent me this. Apparently it's some sort of magical repellant that will make the hyenas run in fear when they sniff it. Treat the corpses of as many Imperial soldiers as you can find. But don't bother with those League corpses - let 'em dine on our enemy's flesh!
We must preserve our soldiers! We aren't likely to get new ones any time soon!

The bodies of the fallen are now safe. Before long those warriors will return to the battlefield and charge the enemy with even greater fury, hungry to avenge their deaths. You've been very helpful, and the Empire won't soon forget it!
Collect 3 League Swords and 3 League Spears and deliver them to Swamper the Merciless.

We're in dire need of new weapons. It's gotten so bad that some ignorant soldiers have started rumors about it. They say that we're holding out and giving the best blades to elite forces. Cretins!
The real problem is that the last arms shipment from Nezebgrad was intercepted and destroyed by a League ship. Hence our predicament!
Now I've got a plan to get us some weapons and get even with the League at the same time. Go out to the battlefield, and if you see a wounded League soldier - finish him off with this here dagger. Then take their weapons and bring them to me. And don't hesitate to scavenge from those that are already dead, too!
But don't bother cutting their heads off - those hyenas are doing that kind of work for us. Hah! Then we can claim the Empire is merciful, too, which should get us in good with those Historian types.
Where are my weapons? We must arm our soldiers, lest they go into battle with makeshift clubs in their hands, like some savages!
So, what have we got here? Some dents, light rusting... Well, the blades need a bit of cleaning and sharpening, no big whoop! Every weapon remains fully functional. Thanks for your help!
Check the three sentry outposts between the Central Imperial Camp and the SCOSS and report back to Kirill Sechin.

Soon, very soon, we will launch an all-out offensive. And so we must make sure that every little detail is taken care of, just in case of any surprises.
To the east of here is the Storehouse Complex on the Southern Shore, or SCOSS for short. It holds our supplies of arms and rations, and it's also storing a shipment of experimental missiles from Nezebgrad. I trust you realize the strategic importance of this facility.
Thus, the matter of its security is crucial. Should the enemy take it over, our offense would crumble very quickly.
So heed my order carefully! You are to inspect the three sentry outposts between here and the SCOSS. When soldiers are left to themselves for a long period of time, they tend to start lacking in their duties. Make sure they are ready for battle!
Well? How are the outposts doing?

What?! They're being assaulted as we speak? What a disgrace! They should be keeping their guard up to prevent that sort of stuff! Good thing I had you check up on them.
On behalf of the Imperial command, please accept our gratitude for your actions! As far as these rats go, they better get their sleepy heads ready for a tribunal!
Report to Kirill Sechin upon completion of quests "Permission for Nefer Ur," "Inspection" and "June Stronghold."

Victory is near!
You have three important quests left: "Permission for Nefer Ur," "Inspection" and "June Stronghold."
I will await you eagerly. I hope that you will bring me news of victory soon!

Well? Got good news for me?
Report on a successful completion of your tasks.

There it is!
Skillful leadership by yours truly and unprecedented heroism demonstrated by you have led us to victory.
The League is defeated, crushed, demoralized.
We've done well, real well!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Gather 6 League Fliers from around the Central Imperial Camp and bring them to Vlada Merinova.

We've got plenty of reinforcements now!

Quick hands, keen eyes, tenacious minds - we can use it all.

The central region of the Holy Land is called "Asee-Teph." It means "Tep's Grave" in the ancient language of the Zem, since it was this pyramid that became the madman's grave. They say he spent a thousand years in there, dying from his own plague and coming back to life. Until the pyramid captured Tensess' soul, that is. So the pyramid became the grave for the Great Mage of Kania! That's how it got the name Tensess Temple.

Now, why am I telling you all this? Because these ideological nuances constitute the very foundation of subversive enemy propaganda spread by the League's agents who infiltrate our home front. We've had some success in identifying and capturing these agitators. With your help we hope to find those who've managed to elude us so far.

You are to set out at once! Someone is hanging anti-Empire flyers all over the walls of the camp. Gather six of those and bring them to me.

The League is trying their best to sow unrest among our ranks! They are spreading panic and undermining our faith in the doctrines of the Trinity Church. But we'll put an end to that soon enough, just you watch. Now where are the fliers?

Let's see what we've got here! "Soldiers of the Empire, you have been deceived..." And so on and so forth.
The text is well-written, tinged with just the right spark of emotion - it's clear we're dealing with a professional agitator. We must learn who's writing and circulating these fliers. And I've already got plenty of leads to start with.
Go to the Site of Power in the Central Imperial Camp and return to Braid the Bloodthirsty.

Who are you? A seasoned soldier or just a recruit? Eh, doesn't matter. We need everyone we can get.
The situation is downright rotten. Initially we hoped to drive out the League with just the force of our regular army. But the League ended up being a tougher nut than we anticipated. So tough that we broke all our teeth trying to crack it. A lesson learned - never underestimate your enemy.
Now we're in a state of full mobilization, with reinforcements arriving regularly by ship. Newbies green as grass are essentially fertilizer for this damn jungle. We've got ourselves a meat grinder here, take my word for it. And it can get you minced real fast, regardless of your experience.
Now let me get straight to the point. At the center of the allod is Tensess Temple, which currently contains Tensess' soul. The Temple is overflowing with holy magic, and now the power is actually spreading throughout the jungle. There are streams of holy magic actually flowing out of the ground at special Sites of Power.
It should come as no surprise that one such Site is located right here in our camp. Go there and bask in the power to get a taste of what's out there. Come back to me when you understand what is at stake.
We are engaged in continuous struggle with the League for the Sites of Power. Whichever side controls more of them enjoys an undisputed advantage.

Did you go to the site yet? Good! Remember to use the holy magic from the Sites of Power whenever you can.
The League continues to control half the allod, but with help like you I'm sure we'll drive them off soon! The Holy Land ought to belong to the Empire.
Capture the guard tower by killing 6 League Soldiers and their commander Marat Besonov. Report back to Kirill Sechin in the Central Imperial Camp.

Finally Yasker has signed an order to commence with decisive measures! About damn time!
Today our troops will break the front line and attack all the League outposts in all directions. I have no doubt that the League will shudder, break, and scuttle away. And then the Holy Land will be ours!
You shall be entrusted with a special mission. There's a guard tower that stands between the Central League Camp and Tensess Temple. It is a crucial strategic point, and controlling it essentially guarantees a successful assault on the League base.
Kill as many of the guards as possible, and remove Marat Besonov, their commander. He's a dangerous foe who fought side by side with Voisvet Belov himself. He won't be easy to defeat, but I believe in you. And through me the entire Empire believes in you. Anything less than complete victory is unacceptable!
Is the League's guard tower captured? Is Insomnian dead?
Splendid! Your heroic deeds merit the highest praise. With this tactical advantage, we'll be able to execute a successful assault. The time has come to rid the Holy Land of the invaders!
Use the Ogre Guardian's Capsule at the Central League Camp and report back to Kirill Sechin.

We are about to launch our main attack on the League base. We must make sure that it's successful, and that's why I'm sending you on a special mission.
Remember the Bone Guardian's Capsule? Well, this time we've got something even better. Don't ask me how the Imperial scientists managed to bring a ferocious ogre under their control. I heard rumors that it was actually an accident, a side effect of some sinister experiment conducted in the fabled Lab Thirteen! But let's keep all that between us.
Behold the Ogre Guardian's Capsule. It's to be set at the Site of Power in the middle of the Central League Camp, at which point a giant ogre will pop out and raze the whole place to the ground. And you're the one I've decided to entrust with this honorary mission.
Was the capsule used near the League base? Is the beast crushing enemy soldiers as we speak?

That monster is a superb fighter. What I wouldn't give to have a whole brigade of such beasts under my command! Still, even he can't deal with the entire League base. We need to dispatch soldiers to back him up immediately.
Launch the Experimental Missile at the Central League Camp with the secret catapult and report back to the Vlada Merinova.

Sechin received orders to begin our offensive maneuvers against the League. And so the time has come for us to answer their challenge.
We've been keeping an ace up our sleeve that we're finally ready to use. And trust me when I say that it won't go over well with the enemy.
Thanks to our Arisen scientists we are now in possession of experimental missiles that contain hallucinogenic gas. The results are stunning! One whiff of this stuff and the enemy becomes completely deranged and utterly useless to their allies.
A catapult has already been delivered to a secret location just to the east of the main League camp. All you need to do it make your way over there and fire this missile.
The gas causes hallucinations of various kinds - some see monsters, others see naked women... Either way, combat will be the last thing on the League soldiers' minds! Good job!
Meet with Colonel Georgi Batalov in the Kotelny Camp and tell him about the demons in the Holy Land.

I know very little about this garbage concerning demons and cultists. Where they're from, why they came, their rituals - all that stuff is too complicated for an Orcish mind. But I do know who can help us.
To the west of here, in a region called Eljune, is a garrison called the Kotelny Camp and it is led by a Xadaganian named Georgi Batalov. But he's not just any commander. No! Whatever combat operations go on over there are child's play to him, something to pass the time after retirement. He's a veteran of the Great Astral Campaign!
If anyone stared death straight in the face and knows a thing or two about demons - it's Batalov. He ought to take over this matter on account of his extensive experience. Visit him as soon as possible and tell him everything you've learned.

Demons and cultists? I wish I could say I'm surprised by this news.
Aye, they've been appearing more and more recently. Deja-vu is what the Elves call it, if I'm not mistaken. Old and wicked events of the past coming back to haunt me.
I reckon that the problem isn't restricted to Asee-Teph, but that we may soon see them here in Eljune too. All this worries me a great deal.
Meet with Anatoly Aldanov outside of Tensess Temple.

There's bad news, and then there's really bad news. Which do you want to hear first?
Very well. Nefer Ur was unable to obtain enter the Temple after all! They said that he needed permission from more than one Historian, and no one else would grant it. The Historians rejected both his request and that of Voisvet Belov. That's the bad news.
The really bad news is that the insidious League has violated the agreement with the Historians. One dark night the Kanians attacked the Historians' mercenaries, and then Voisvet and his people snuck into the Temple. Nefer Ur had no choice but to go after them.
Now the Historians are threatening to break off all agreements with the League and with us. This may lead to an outright battle for control of the Temple - a battle we're not ready for.
And imagine what would happen if the Temple was destroyed in that battle, and Tensess' soul was lost! We would lose his gift, and that would mean that if you died, you wouldn't rise back to life. Your death would be final and complete, just as it would have been decades ago.
That is why we must fix this situation. Go and reconcile with the Historians, get their permission to enter the Temple, and assist Nefer Ur in routing out the League! Our diplomat, Anatoly Aldanov, is currently waiting outside the Temple. Go to him and ask him for help.

It's good that you're here, as I will need your help. The Historians no longer trust anyone, and their mercenaries don't let anyone near the Temple. The situation is highly delicate, but we must do everything possible not to violate the agreement. Convincing them that the attack was organized by the League won't be easy, but the truth is still on our side!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Kill 6 League Defenders. Report back to Anatoly Aldanov in Tensess Temple.

We've got several jobs ahead of us. The first one is directly related to enemy activity. The League is amassing combat forces outside the Temple. Now they're not some green militia or even seasoned veterans, mind you. No, they're sending in the best of the best.
These soldiers are true masters of combat, the absolute elite of their army. I don't know how events will continue to unfold, but armed conflict appears inevitable. That means we need to gain an advantage sooner rather than later.
I believe my orders should be pretty obvious. Take out those soldiers immediately, before they have a chance to lay their blades to our camp.
Those are seasoned warriors who'll bulldoze a rookie before they know what hit 'em. They must be neutralized before combat even begins!
The League should soon seek to resolve the situation peacefully. After all, should the conflict escalate, we now have the upper hand! The League's chances at victory are virtually nonexistent!
Find the wounded Orcish mercenary at the League outpost by Tensess Temple.

Efforts are underway to resume negotiations with the Historians. We haven't lost hope. But first we need proof that the assault in the night was Orchestrated by the League. That they're the ones who broke the agreement first!
I say we've got a shot at this thing, but you'll need to work a bit to make it happen. At a League outpost on the other side of the Temple our scouts spotted a wounded Orcish from the Historians' mercenary squad. The League will do whatever it takes to make sure he testifies in their favor! And we need him to do the exact opposite. You follow me?
But keep in mind that he's under guard at all times. You'll have to break through their ranks and get him to tell you his story.

Why, look at you! You don't look like those dolled up Elves. Damn them and their incessant questions! Those dandies are trying to bedevil me, I just know it!
By the way, it was the League that attacked us last night. Wormy cowards! Just as I was about to hit the sack after a long shift. And now these jackals want me the blame the raid on the Empire. They even offered me money. Well, I ain't for sale!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Escort Bailer the Merciless to the Historians' base and report back to Anatoly Aldanov.

I'm an honest Orc! And I'll never bend to anyone, no matter what they offer. That's why I never joined the Imperial Army - you can't exactly speak your mind there, you know. You do what they tell you and you don't talk back.
Anyway, if you escort me back to the Historians' base, I'll tell 'em the whole story straight, just as it happened. Orc's honor! Then they'll know that the Empire is telling the truth. But these League soldiers won't let us outta here just like that. We'll need to fight our way out!
Did you save the Orc? Without his testimony our arguments will be groundless!
With a witness like that on our side, we've got a major advantage! The Historians will believe us for sure. And then the League will be exposed for what they are!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Travel to the Historians' base and seek out Vissarion Arhivin.

Now that we've got a reliable witness we may begin negotiations with the Historians. Take this white flag, otherwise their mercenaries won't let you near their base. You must meet with Vissarion Arhivin, the Historians' leader in Asee-Teph, and relay to him all that we've learned!
It's good that the Historians' representative here is a Xadaganian, and not Zayan de Desirae. I bet that deep in his soul Arhivin remains loyal to the Empire, which plays in our favor.
Now hurry, and make sure to act as politely as possible! The situation is still very delicate and we can't afford to go to war with the Historians.

Unfortunately, Chairman Arhivin isn't here. Maybe I can help you? The camp is in chaos from all that's happened here recently. After the attack in the night, Arhivin instituted martial law amongst the Historians and headed straight for the Temple himself.
Before leaving he gave express orders not to enter into any negotiations, and to let the League and the Empire sort things out amongst themselves. That's all I know. Why, is there any news I should know about that could sway my decision?

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Relay the information to Anatoly Aldanov, the Imperial diplomat.

The Orcish mercenary's testimony changes everything! And yet, unfortunately, I'm not authorized to make decisions on matters of this magnitude. The only one who can ultimately decide who is right is Vissarion Arhivin himself.
You should go inside the Temple and follow him. He went in one of the side entrances, after the members of the League and the Empire. He can't be that far in, and hopefully the situation you'll find will be peaceful.
But be sure to talk to your diplomat before heading out. Now that we've stopped being the mediators in this conflict between the League and the Empire, only he permit you access to the Temple.
So you say that Chairman Vissarion Arhivin followed Nefer Ur and Voisvet Belov into the Temple? If you ask me, that place is getting too crowded! I wonder what he's looking for...

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Use 3 Bone Guardian's Capsules at the Site of Power near Misty Slope.

Well, are you ready to serve the Motherland? All Imperial forces in the Holy Land are under my command, and I report straight to Yasker. And you shall report straight to me. Treat this as a token of my great trust in you.
I have a myriad of orders, and I doubt that you'll be able to handle them all. But let's get started and see how it goes. My first order concerns Misty Slope, which is west of Tensess Temple. Let me explain the situation.
The Empire is trying to set up artillery at the highest point of a nearby slope. We'd be able to cover all of the Temple surroundings with support fire if we took that area. The League troops stationed at Misty Slope are impeding our efforts, so I'm give you these Bone Guardian's Capsules.
They're one of the latest inventions from the scientists over at the ZIT, and when you use one out pops a giant skeleton. Use them near the Site of Power close to Misty Slope and the League will be in for a very unpleasant surprise.

The elevation near Misty Slope is about the same as the top of Tensess Temple. With everything around in full view, you couldn't ask for a better shooting spot! So, are the Bone Guardian's Capsules already set?
The Bone Guardians have awoken, which gives us a sure shot at recapturing that area from the League. Thank Nezeb for the magic of the Arisen!
Collect 6 pieces of Thick Spider Web and bring them to Sarbaz Meritites at Misty Slope.

Damn this place. And damn these orders!
We were told to take the high ground, but how are we going to get the cannons up there? The ropes won't hold.
Our cannons are made of the strongest steel, but a fall from this height will destroy them. Hm, I think it's high time I applied some of that resourcefulness my people are known for. What have we got around here that could work...?
Spiders... Hmm...
I've got it! We can strengthen the ropes using spider webs! About six pieces should do the trick. Now hurry up and go get some!
Where are the webs? We must move the cannons immediately. We need to go before the Kanians attempt a counterattack. Then we wouldn't have anything left to bring up!

Ugh, this stuff is so nasty! I don't want to touch it, but this is no time to be fussy... We'll use this filth to strengthen the ropes, and then we'll bring up the cannons without a hitch. Those Kanians are as good as gone!
Kill 6 League Militants or League Veterans, and 1 League Officer. Report back to Crookedclaw the Nomadic at Misty Slope.

Why are you still standing there? You wanna die?! Well then you're in the right place, I guess. Looks like the League is planning an operation to capture Misty Slope, one we might not survive.
Just the other day a whole squad of veterans and militia came to their camp, the one to the north. And as ill luck would have it, half of my soldiers are down with a stomach flu, the other half are guarding the camp, while the third half haven't risen from their last battle. What a mess!
We cannot afford to wait. We must attack first and destroy their reinforcements right away! Let 'em know this ain't no vacation spot! Now make for the enemy camp and massacre the bastards!
Well?! Did you complete my task? Are the reinforcements dead?

Excellent! I'm sure that their sergeant was up to something sinister. Now we've gone and reduced his plans to dust, haha! Sooner than later we'll push the League all the way to the northern shore. Yes, that's exactly how it'll be!
Burn all 3 League catapults, kill 3 League Bombers, and report back to Crookedclaw the Nomadic.

I'm convinced - this blasted allod is cursed! The other day the League moved their catapults to the top of the hill, and they've been bombing us ever since! We try to answer, of course, giving 'em a taste of their own medicine, but it's almost impossible as long as they hold that hill!
A little while ago I personally loaded our catapult with a Kanian missile which had fallen near our camp the day before, and I wouldn't be surprised if that same damn rock hits me on the head tomorrow! We're having all sorts of bad luck!
Long story short, we need those catapults decommissioned. We took out the ones that are on the hill for now, but they have a lot more of them at their base to the north.
Go burn 'em down before they're ever deployed. I suppose you'll need to hack through the guards first. Just as well, if you ask me. Now move out!
Are the catapults destroyed? We need them taken out now - the troops are about to attack!

I can see the smoke rising up into the air! Excellent! Now we can assault the enemy without fear of coming under fire. Any coward can hurl missiles around, but let's see what they can do against good ol' steel!
Set the Large Signal Beacon at the entrance to the Jungle Mine and report back to Kirill Sechin.

Ready for more orders? Excellent! To the north of here, near the main League base, there is a mine full of meteorite ore. It is a very deep mine, and the League has been able to extract an incredible amount of resources from it.
They keep it under very heavy guard, which makes direct assault nearly impossible. For that reason we've been conducting subversive operations in the area for a while, and now we're about to step it up a notch.
You are to make your way to the mine's entrance and plant a beacon in front of it. Our ships will move up to the coast and use the beacon to find the mine and then bombard it with missiles, caving in the entrance and effectively halting the League's operations. Now go and do your part, soldier!
Meteorite ore is a rather crucial resource. We cannot allow the League to mine it right under our noses. I trust that the beacon is set?
The beacon is up and running, and our ships will soon open fire on the mines. This will help us reach a turning point in the war for the Holy Land!
Find the saboteurs' hideout near the Jungle Mine.

Phew, I'm finally home. Yes, home! This camp became home to me a long time ago. I've been living in the Holy Land for two years you know!
I just returned from the northern coast of Asee-Teph. My team and I were conducting subversive operations near the Jungle Mine. You'd need a month to calculate all the damage we've caused!
All the mine cars we've 'let slip' downhill and the miners' wells we've filled with all kinds of filth. We even managed to set a flock of harpies on the mine, though they pecked us a bit as well.
My comrades remained in our secret hideout near the Mine, and they're in dire need of assistance. Follow the markers, disguised as tropical flowers, and you'll find them. It might be a little hard to spot, but in our line of work secrecy is everything.
We were worried that Maya hadn't make it back to the main camp and sent us aid. But now that you're here, we can battle the League once again!
I'm glad that you were able to find the place. We won't be able to hold out much longer without your aid!
Bring 6 pieces of Tough Boar Meat to Miroslav Zaykin in Asee-Teph.

If you want to join a weight-loss program, you've come to the right place! Won't take long at all!
My buddies and I have been taken off the front lines and dispatched to this here hideout. The League is mining meteorite ore to make their Astral ships on the shore. A very important resource, they tell me! I bet that's why the League is so gung-ho about capturing this allod, while the holy magic and that Tensess character are just an excuse. But that mine won't stay operational for long, just you watch.
But before we get to that, we better regain our strength. The boys are starving. Barely standing, in fact. Being a saboteur ain't the easiest thing in the world, you know.
Bring us six pieces of boar meat, please! It sucks to work on an empty stomach. Where can you find boars? Try the jungle right above us!
Ugh, my stomach won't stop rumbling! I guess we can cook my belt. Maybe the gloves too, provided they'd been worn long enough. But I have to say, I like boar's meat the best!

We're saved! Now let's bake the meat on the rocks, and save a few pieces for future rations as well. And we need to fry ourselves some pork rinds! The League better watch out now that we have a full belly.
Use the Scroll of the Rusty Curse to sabotage 6 Crates of Meteorite Ore. Report back to Hila the Forester in Asee-Teph.

So, wanna join us and mess with the League? Good. Here, take this scroll. It's bound with a special spell called the "Rusty Curse".
The spell can cause anything to rust, and the targets are going to be the crates of meteorite ore in the Jungle Mines. If we can't stop the League from mining stuff, at least we can make whatever they get useless!
And the best part is, no matter what anyone does, it's completely impossible to remove the magical rust. And the more ore we ruin, the more of the League's ships will remain stuck in their harbors waiting on repairs.
Go sneak into that mine and use the scroll on five crates of meteorite ore, then return to me. But watch out for miners and guards, and make sure you don't lose the scroll!
You couldn't get to the crates? Well, don't just give up, just give it another try!

Excellent! The miners might as well dump all their rusty ore into the Astral for all the good it does them! That was a heck of a mission, wasn't it?! By depriving them of raw materials, we're one step closer to bringing the League to its knees!
Place the sign at the Site of Power near the Jungle Mine and report back to Yasskul Setepenre.

I have a job for you. You could even say that the job isn't just from me, but from he entire Trinity Church.
There's a Site of Power near the Jungle Mine. The League's church has proclaimed the area sacred and sent a group of knights to stand guard.
Some even claim to have glimpsed Tensess' spirit at the Site! Of course, if anyone were to spend a week inside that mine with its stuffy air and noxious fumes, they'd start seeing things too.
That said, the magic at that Site of Power is still formidable. Pilgrims have now taken to visiting it from the League's other allods. Well, we've decided to play a little prank that will sure get a rise out of them!
Read what it says on this here sign - "Nezeb Was Here." Plant it next to the Site of Power and they're sure to get in a tizzy. You might need to fight a few knights to make it happen, but I'm sure it'll be worth it!
We must plant the sign at the Site of Power as soon as possible! This will serve as our response to the ideological war, unleashed by the League against the Empire.

Is the sign in place? Wonderful! I can imagine how angry those pilgrims must be! I'm sure you know that the League holds religion to be extremely important. Their Church of Light is like a breeding ground for raving zealots!
Ooh, how I wanna to be there when those pompous upstarts get railroaded by their brass for letting the Site get 'defiled'! They'll blow their tops for sure!
Get a Historians' Brochure from the Historians' camp near Uskul the Dead City and bring it to Vlada Merinova.

Say, do you know anything about the Historians? Not our Imperial ones. I'm talking about the group that's neutral to both the League and the Empire. The research everything about the history of Sarnaut, and they're here in the Holy Land researching the June civilization.
They're mainly haughty highbrows who only care about the past. The concept of the 'present' doesn't even register. They're headed by an Elven Great Mage named Zayan, author of the famous "Chronicles of Yesteryear."
His authority among the Great Mages is so enormous that both the League and the Empire have agreed to let the Historians act as a kind of neutral shield to protect Tensess Temple. Meaning they are the only ones who are allowed access.
I don't really believe all that neutrality stuff. And take a look at this flier you got off the camps' walls. The paper it's printed on didn't come from the Empire. And there are only two other powers in the world able to work a printing press - the Historians and the League.
Visit the Historians and obtain a sample of their paper. A brochure, for example. It might match the kind those fliers were printed on! You should be able to find some Historians in their camp near Uskul. I don't know exactly how you'll get the paper, but just figure something out!
How's it going with the Historians? I need a sample of their paper! Without it our investigation hits a dead end!

Let's have a look at this brochure! Hmm, it seems our theory has been debunked. The fliers that were posted around the camp and this brochure were printed on different paper. Oh well! I suppose we can trust the Historians. For now.
Kill 6 Groaning Banshees and report back to Kirill Sechin in the Central Imperial Camp.

I've got new orders for you.

The situation at the Uskul the Dead City has become a bit of a concern.

Those ancient June ruins aren't of interest to anyone but the Historians. However, there's a Site of Power nearby and we must retain control over it. The problem is that I keep losing soldiers over there. The ruins are teeming with banshees. Trying to reach any kind of agreement with them is the very definition of a lost cause. Nothing will stop them from attacking and killing people. Even the peaceful Historians! It would be a good idea to stay on the Historians' good side.

Please eliminate six banshees.

I forgot to mention that at certain times of the month the banshees become extremely aggressive. We're not sure what causes it, but hopefully they're slightly less vicious right now so you can give them a good thrashing.

Did the banshees learn their lesson? Excellent. Nothing can get in the way of the Empire's efforts to liberate the Holy Land - not League soldiers, not savage aborigines, not predatory beasts. We will crush all our enemies in the name of the Yasker!
Report to Kirill Sechin upon completion of quests "Jungle Mine," "Bone Guardians" and "Disruptive Banshees."

Everyone who comes to Asee-Teph fancies himself a great military leader and charges to start cutting down League fighters left and right. In the best case scenario he gets real familiar with the Purgatory.
Well, I'm sick and tired of this script repeating itself, so now we'll all be following my plan of attack. Bit by bit we will weaken the League in all areas. I will assign you quests in phases: once you complete the first phase, you'll graduate to another.
All clear?
The first phase of the plan is simple: complete the following three quests: Jungle Mine, Bone Guardians and Disruptive Banshees.
Did you complete the three quests from the first phase?
Excellent. Everything is going according to plan.
Kill Selifan Briskov, Rostislav Sherengov, and Kazimir Gusev and report back to Kirill Sechin.

The situation at the Imperial Outpost has become quite troubling. Not long ago the League landed a squad of paratroopers on the shore, and we were able to defeat most of the enemies. However, some of them escaped into the nearby jungle and have been waging guerrilla warfare ever since.
According to our data, the guerrillas are concentrated in three camps. They appear to have a leader based in each area, and their names are Selifan Briskov, Rostislav Sherengov, Kazimir Gusev.
These are my orders! Make for the jungle to the northeast, find the three guerrilla commanders, and neutralize them. On the way there I'd also suggest you drop by the Imperial Outpost. The soldiers are probably in need of your help as well. Now go and serve the Empire with pride!
Are the guerrilla commanders neutralized? We cannot delay this mission any longer - they're causing us to suffer major losses!

We have beheaded the guerrilla movement at last. I shall dispatch a brigade at once to comb through the jungle and destroy whatever enemies remain! And you have my gratitude for serving the Empire with excellence and devotion.
Kill 6 League Guerrillas and report back to Zinoviy Oskolkin.

The situation at the Imperial Outpost, of which I am the rightful overseer, was peaceful until the League dropped paratroopers on our shore.
We routed the enemy, but a portion of the paratroopers managed to escape into the jungle, where they currently engage in subversive behavior close to our main base. They butcher our soldiers, steal our weapons, and they even poisoned our water supply!
The Imperial command demands that we secure this area by neutralizing the guerrilla threat. But to tell you the truth, we need help. We can't do it alone.
Please give us a hand! Seek out the League guerrillas in the jungle and kill them. Then we can sleep peacefully at night once again.
I've already drafted a report stating that the League guerrillas in the region have been neutralized. I hope I won't need to feed it to the fire! Are the guerrillas dead?

Finally the guerrillas have taken heavy losses. I've wanted to wipe them out for a long time, but most of my soldiers aren't seasoned enough to operate in the harsh conditions of the jungle. Thank you for finally stepping in and doing the job.
Kill three guerrilla ambushers and report back to Slasher the Unyielding.

Man, dealing with these green horns is a real nightmare. You and I are proper soldiers, but these suckers drop like flies at the first sign of danger.
It's up to us to help them hold out a bit longer. The League guerrillas have taken to setting up ambushes on the road to the main camp. They're killing our couriers, postal workers, and even water carriers! We must put a stop to it.
Here, put this cap on and head up that road, as though you're an innocent postal worker. Those bastards are sure to ambush you, and when they do butcher those guerrillas immediately! My sources say that there are three ambush spots along the road. Wipe them out, one by one!
Are the ambushers destroyed? Don't tell me the guerrillas figured out your little trick!

Haha, they got what was coming to them!
Now we've restored communication with the main camp, and we don't have to worry about our couriers. At last we'll be getting our mail, the humor section of the newspaper, crossword puzzles... Thanks for your help!
Bring 6 Tapir Teeth to Sarang Nebtu.

Hmm, maybe we could try tree bark... They say it's got healing properties... No, too risky! Oh, I'm sorry, I'm just talking to myself. No, nothing female related! More of a general problem, actually.
The League guerrillas have poisoned our main water source, and that's all the troops have to drink. Now there's an all-out epidemic among the soldiers. A double epidemic, no less - dysentery and scrofula.
I'm doing everything I can, but I don't know how to cure them with our current resources! What if the guerrillas decide to take advantage of our situation and attack the camp? We wouldn't be able to fight them off!
There's hope, though. I have heard of one remedy that I might be able to whip up. It's a mixture of ground tapir teeth and various plant ingredients. Care to lend me a hand and bring me back some of those teeth?
The whole camp is suffering from diarrhea. I can't imagine anything more embarrassing, but we'll pull through this together! Where are those tapir teeth?

Now I'll get those soldiers back on their feet in no time.
I've already instructed the troops to stop drinking water raw - from now on they'll be boiling and filtering everything. That's the only way we can be sure to avoid another epidemic. Thanks for your help!
Find a clue related to the Predator in the Tekyan Thicket.

Your next mission may seem a bit unusual.

East of Tensess Temple is the Tekyan Thicket. According to the Historians, the name means "Predatory Thicket" in the June language.

It is also where the front line currently runs through. Now, we'll push the enemy out of the grove soon enough, but as of this moment we're being greatly hindered by the impenetrable jungle and its predators. On top of that, we've been getting reports of a monster attacking both League and Imperial soldiers with equal fury. The victims disappear without a trace and none get resurrected!

Troops have taken to calling this beast the Predator. It's probably some wild animal, maybe a tiger or a giant crocodile. Or some other creature unknown to us.

But whatever it is, you need to find it and kill it. Go search for some clues so you can track down its lair.

It appears to be a badly mangled Gibberling. The thing never had a chance against whatever attacked it. These bite marks look too big to belong to any normal jungle creature, so it must have been the work of the Predator.
Kill 6 Jungle Tigers and report back to Timofey Glazunov.

Ugh, these new recruits will be the end of me.
Especially those Suslanger ones. Apparently, back home tigers are considered dangerous creatures that are best left alone. Imagine that! Blasted cowards! You can't force 'em outside at sword point!
As you can see, we've got ourselves a problem here. As long as tigers rule the roost in this thicket, war is the last thing on my recruits' minds. That's 'cause the tigers have had themselves some human meat, and they seem to have taken a liking to it.
It'd be good to reduce their headcount some. Care to help out? Kill as many of the beasts as you can and come back to me when it's safe for the more cowardly types.

How goes the hunt?
We're dealing with deadly beasts here - their claws are as sharp as our blades. It's either us or them. There's no third option!
We're finally beginning to hold our own against these beasts. Lords of the jungle my butt!
Escort the Blazing Elemental to the Site of Power by feeding it Dried Braches along the way and report back to Nomarkh Nikare.

My platoon has been charged with the task of seizing control over the Site of Power in the Tekyan Thicket. We must capture it before it's overtaken by the League forces. To help us get through the impenetrable jungle, I've decided to use a bit of magic!
I'll create a fire elemental who will burn down these trees and thus make a path to the Site of Power. I'll need your help as well, though.
Your job is to protect the elemental from predators and enemy troops. And don't forget to feed it dried branches along the way! His flame will go out and he won't be able to complete his mission if you don't.
I shall call this elemental "Torch" and he shall be my loyal minion!

I knew that he would make it. Nothing can withstand the mighty fury of "Torch"! Mental note - patent the invention at the ZIT. A fire elemental of such power can become a superb weapon. Anyhow, your assistance in clearing the way to the Site of Power has been invaluable! I will certainly make a note of it in my report to Colonel Sechin!
Bring the Predator's Heart to Braid the Bloodthirsty.

This heart needs to be delivered to Colonel Braid the Bloodthirsty at the Central Imperial Camp. Tell him that this demon may not be alone out there. Something odd is afoot in the Holy Land, and we must be ready for any surprises.
You met a Demon Hunter? Well, what did he say?

Damnation! It turns out the Predator was a demon after all! But why has he been hanging around here? Whatever the case may be, this news is pretty terrible.
We've had enough of fighting demons in the Great Astral Campaign. This war is supposed to be about fighting the League! I hope we don't have to turn to the Demon Hunters for help.
Kill a League Missionary and take his uniform. While wearing the uniform, kill 6 Lamias. Report back to Kirill Sechin in the Central Imperial Camp.

In order to complete your next mission you'll need to go beyond the front lines and into enemy territory. One of Asee-Teph's Sites of Power is located in a lamia settlement near Kotick the Dead City, in the northern region of the allod.
Lamias are proud and willful creatures, but somehow the League managed to weasel them into an alliance! Naturally, we can't have that. Lamias must reconsider their allegiance, and I've got just the plan to make that happen.
You'll help me Orchestrate a devious plan! You are to kill a League missionary, take his uniform, and disguise yourself as the enemy. Then you are to kill as many lamias as possible! We must ignite flames of hatred in their stone cold hearts!
All's fair in times of war! The lamias will think that it was a League soldier that attacked their friends. So, did you manage to deceive them?

Lamias are fine warriors, and we cannot have them partnering up with the League! I hope that our plan works. Then the lamias will cross over to our side in a flash. We will perpetrate a massacre of such magnitude that their hate for the League won't subside for ages!
Bring 6 Missionaries' Leaflets to Vlada Merinova.

Well, we've essentially ruled out the Historians as the source of these horrible fliers. Who does that mean is left? That's right - the League!
There's simply no other alternative, and I'm completely sure that I'm right. However, protocol requires that I obtain samples of their printed materials as proof. The Empire is always completely thorough in their investigations!
I know that the League recently dispatched several missionaries to the lamia settlement near Kotick the Dead City. They're sure to be carrying tons of literature on the doctrines of their Church of Light. Kill them and bring me some samples, so that I may match the paper to these fliers.
This job is beyond boring, but someone's gotta do it! So where are those propaganda materials from the missionaries?

Now let's compare these leaflets with the fliers posted throughout the base... It's conclusive - the paper and the font are an exact match! The fliers were printed by the League! No matter, in this ideological war it is we who will emerge victorious. And I think it is time for us to get our revenge!
Report to Kirill Sechin upon completion of quests The Three Commanders, A Devious Provocation and The Predator's Tracks.

The next three quests will take you to Tekyan Thicket, Kotick the Dead City and the Imperial Outpost.
I'm talking about the following quests: The Three Commanders, A Devious Provocation and The Predator's Tracks.
Complete these quests and we'll be able to move on to the third phase.
Did you complete the three quests from the second phase?
Hmm... Not bad! You're handling my assignments very well.

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Go to the Site of Power near the Overcharged Shore and scout the situation.

There were several important decisions made at a recent meeting. The sabotage at the Jungle Mine is to be supplemented with an assault landing of Imperial paratroopers.
But first we must to secure a foothold on the Overcharged Shore in the northwestern region of Asee-Teph. Then we can fortify our position and regroup our forces for a subsequent blow to the Central League Camp.
As you can imagine, we cannot commence an operation of this magnitude without a thorough recon effort first. That's where you come in.
The Site of Power near the Overcharged Shore is only guarded by a small League squad. That's the old data, anyway. But some of the Imperial agents that were deployed to that region in recent weeks haven't returned.
There's a possibility that the League has decided to reinforce their outpost, having realized the weakness of their territorial position. Head over there and learn the field strength of enemy troops. But don't engage in any combat! Do you understand?
Help me, please! I don't care who you are - this region has been taken over by demon worshippers! They're enemies to everyone! You must help!
Tell Colonel Braid the Bloodthirsty about the events that took place near the Overcharged Shore.

As you can see, our efforts have failed! The Site of Power was revived momentarily, but then the flow of holy energy dried up again.
The cultists' ritual has sucked all the magic out of the Site of Power. But why? What is their agenda? And where did they get that kind of power?
This is extremely troubling. It was said that the demonic threat had been neutralized once and for all. But before us are cultists that worship their kind. Maybe our leaders were wrong...
You are the enemy, so what I'm about to ask you makes me a traitor. But some things are above this war, and this is one of them. Return to your camp and tell your leaders everything that happened! They also battled the demons way back when, so perhaps now they'll battle them once more!

I'm pretty sure that broad was exaggerating. The demonic threat has been neutralized once and for all. My father was among the heroes who died a valiant death in the Great Astral Campaign. Now I'm supposed to believe some Kanian that his death was in vain? Fat chance!
Kill Swampscale and report back to Kirill Sechin.

How you holding up out here? Yeah, I know it's tough, but what can you do? Just gotta buck up and keep on battling until the enemy is destroyed or surrenders. That's the law of this here jungle.
Well, it's time to send you on your next mission. To the west of Tensess Temple lies the Texio Swamp. It's a foul and highly unpleasant place. But you'll find that out for yourself soon enough. There's a Site of Power right at the center of the swamp, but it's an extremely hard location for both us and the League to capture.
Why, you ask? Hydras. Wicked and deadly beasts that attack anyone who dare to step foot in their swamp. And the Site of Power is guarded by none other than Swampscale herself. She's an unholy creature if there ever was one.
Your mission is to liquidate the beast. We must clear the road for the rest of our troops. They've been hiding out at the southeastern edge of the swamp, waiting their chance to move in. Be sure to see them when you're passing by - they may need your help as well.
I'm awaiting your report on Swampscale. Is the monster dead?
Finally, that monster is defeated. The vile creature was responsible for the deaths of countless Imperial soldiers. They are avenged now! Good job, soldier.
Kill 6 League Workers. Report back to Sentinel Stanislav Zabotin at Texio Swamp.

You've been getting a lot of new orders lately, huh? Same old things - capture a Site of Power, butcher a platoon of League soldiers... Am I right? Heh.
While we're here twiddling our thumbs with stupid missions like that, the enemy is wide awake and planning an offensive. How do I know? Because they began building a log road through the swamp, that's how. I bet their plan is to get through the mud with minimal losses and capture our post.
Look, it's not like I'm scared of fighting the League or anything, but the more of their soldiers that get mired down, the better. Head out to their camp and kill ten of their workers. That'll be enough to halt the construction, and it'll take them a while to replace their crew.
Just be prepared to engage in some conflict resolution with the guards as well! They won't let their operations be halted without a fight.
Well? Were you able to disrupt the League's plans?
So the workers are dead? Good. Now their plan is temporarily halted, and in the meantime we can make our move. I will submit this swamp to our rule, whatever it takes!
Bring 3 Thick Crocodile Hides and 3 Thick Hydra Hides to Sarang Akhenaten at Texio Swamp.

Good day! I am Sarang Akhenaten, and I'm in charge of maintaining the soldiers' equipment. Gear wears out real fast here in the jungle, and that's why you see our troops tramping around in rags. And if that weren't enough, any day now there's going to be an inspection! Sechin will have my ass!
It's not my fault that the shipment of materials I ordered is late! Fortunately, there are plenty of hydras and crocodiles around, and their skins will make great replacements.
The problem is I can't take out those beasts myself. Can you help me out and bring me ten skins from each type of beast? Please support your fellow soldier!
Thanks! Now I can take these skins, dry them out, treat them, and finally stretch them out a little bit. Then I can use them to repair the gear before Sechin punishes me!
Set fire to 6 Piles of Wood. Report back to Polina Lazeykina.

Hmm, I'm pretty sure Maya told me about you. She was awarded a medal recently for outstanding subversive activities in enemy territory. Operation "Jungle Mine" ring a bell?
Then again, most soldiers out here deserve a medal. Perhaps I'll get one as well when all this burns to the ground. Literally.
See, here's the thing. When the League finishes constructing their road, their troops will enjoy complete control over the Texio Swamp. Then they'll be able to push the front lines farther south, closer to our main camp. Which is why we need to do all we can to hamper the construction.
I have an operation in mind, but I will need your help. The League workers have piled stacks of wood around their camp to be used in the construction. Take this torch and burn them all to the ground.
So, how do you like starting fires? Me, I love it!
Woo, I smell smoke! I can't wait for the League to start chopping down jungle trees again. Then we can burn even more stuff!
Kill 6 Stone Trolls and their leader, Uhar Thicknose. Report back to Kirill Sechin in the Central Imperial Camp.

Little by little our military presence here in the Holy Land is growing. At the Wild Corner, in the southwest part of Asee-Teph, our forces have begun the construction of a new outpost.
There's one problem, though. The local trolls are not giving us a very warm welcome. I suppose we shouldn't expect much from the savages. Dumb as they are, reaching any kind of an agreement with them is out of the question.
The alternative is clear. Your mission is to kill the trolls and their leader, Uhar Thicknose. Then we can expand the outpost without interference. Soon we will become the dominant force in the Holy Land, I just know it!
I heard that the Historians are writing a book about extinct species. Too bad that trolls can't be part of that book.
The trolls are dead? That's good. It's their own fault, you know. If they cooperated they could've made outstanding soldiers - arms like mountains and rocks for brains. A commander's dream!
Meet with Ignat Zorkin near the Wild Corner.

You and I have been entrusted with a crucial task - to put an end to the anti-Empire propaganda that has been flooding our base. As we speak, our forces are building a new outpost at the Wild Corner, but it looks like League agitators have already infiltrated the area.
An agent of the City Council named Ignat Zorkin reports that they've recently arrested a flier distributor. But we know that he is secretly a tentacle of the League. Our plan is to let him continue his escapade until he reveals the rest of his allies.
Your next mission is to head over to the Wild Corner and aid Ignat however you can. He will soon come to trust you, something we will take advantage of!

I've already mentioned in my report that an enemy agent was arrested with a bundle of fliers and a bucket of glue. An hour into our interrogation, the prisoner told us everything we asked, but it didn't help much to be honest.
He spouted gibberish, saying that he heard the "Voice of the Light" in his head. And that this voice supposedly told him about a spot in the woods where he needed to pick up more fliers.
I know, it sounds like ravings of a madman, but the weird thing is that the lad doesn't seem crazy! It's as though somebody's messing with his consciousness.
Intercept the leaflet suppliers and bring anything of interest to Ignat Zorkin near the Wild Corner.

I'm convinced that this "Voice of the Light" in the prisoner's head is the result of a psionicist. This means that the enemy can be just about anywhere, and it can be just about anyone. So how do we find him?
We've only got one lead at the moment. The prisoner told us the spot where he picked up fresh fliers on a regular basis. Supposedly he was told to go at certain times, after the suppliers had already come and gone. That means he couldn't tell us who delivered them, but you can!
Head over to a spot just west of here, near the base of a large tree and a pond. Wait until the suppliers come by, and then take them out! Bring me back anything of interest so we can solve this mystery.
What happened in the jungle? Did you catch the suppliers, or did they manage to escape?

Hmm, let's see here. What a curious artifact. You see this part here that's made of Astral amber, how it shimmers in the light? I recall reading about this somewhere... Must've been in some City Council report...
But of course! This artifact is used to amplify mind magic! The missionary must've been using it to control our flier boy!
Good thing we found this in time, because some of the troops have started to claim they hear voices! Without this, the League psionicist should be much weaker. Fortunately, I too possess mind magic, and so I am able to resist the manipulations of another!
Distribute 6 Mental Circlets to the nearby Imperial Soldiers and report back to Ignat Zorkin.

By the way, how do you feel? Hearing any voices in your head? That's good. It's probably because you're new here, so your mind is still able to resist the mental pressure. Your temporary immunity should prove invaluable in this mission. Now I can count on you without worrying about your sincerity!
I will now use my powers to trace the source of the enemy's mental emanations. Then we can determine his whereabouts and take him down. Unfortunately it will require a lot of power, so I will need help, and not merely yours.
Distribute these Mental Circlets to our soldiers. When they wear them, we can unite our minds into a single whole. That will grant me enough power to locate the enemy!
Have the circlets been distributed to our brave troops? I need to begin the next stage of my plan as soon as possible.
Now to begin! I shall go into a trance for some time. Please don't disturb me.
Kill the League seers and report to Vlada Merinova at the Central Imperial Camp.

Ugh, that sure wasn't easy... My head is killing me! It was like there wasn't just one enemy psionicist, but three of them at the very least! Why, of course! They were Gibberlings! Three seers, a whole family. That explains why they nearly had me!
But hey, I still pulled it off. Truthfully, it was nothing compared to some of the exams I took to get into the City Council. You'll be pleased to know that I've located their whereabouts. They're to the west of here, near the border of Eljune.
Head over there and kill all three of them! Then you can go back to Merinova and let her know that the League threat has been eliminated. But don't take all the credit now! You couldn't have done it without me, right?
Any news from the Wild Corner?

Hm, it seems I may have been wrong about Viginov, but it doesn't hurt to always keep your guard up! He shall remain under surveillance for a little while longer.
To think that they were using seers! It seems that the League is taking this ideological war very seriously. They're trying to beat us at our own game, but this war is far from over! We shall win it!
Kill 6 Marbled Cobras and report back to Yasskul Djoser in Asee-Teph.

There's a reason this place is called the Wild Corner. Those who consider trolls to be our biggest plight are sorely mistaken. The cobras are a far more serious problem!
I'm the commander of this post. I can't recall a single day when an Imperial soldier didn't die from the bites of those vile beasts.
We've tried all kinds of things, but nothing helps. The brass even sent us an Orcish shaman from the main camp the other day, a snake charmer! Only the damn cobras filled him with gallons of venom before he even knew what happened.
Looks like there's only one solution to our dilemma - and that's kill, kill, and kill again. Of course it will be dangerous, but think of how many lives you can save by risking yours!
So, how many cobras did you kill?
Another twenty, then. Let me mark that down... You're not the first one I've given this task to. With the collective force of the entire army we'll eliminate those beasts before long!
